name: CartoonBus3dModel
notes: Tripo da tach san 27 khoi roi: than xe, 4 banh, 2 can truoc/sau, mat na dau xe, 2 vien hong co hoc banh, 2 can guong + 2 mat guong, ong xa, tay nam, den hau, bien so va cac num nho (tool se tu cho thanh D). Chi con khoi than xe la qua to (9.5 x 4.8 x 5.3) nen chia 3 doan theo chieu dai roi moi doan 4 mui trai/phai x tren/duoi, duong cat ngang roi dung vao nep hong duoi cua so (z~3.3).
